issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: receipts 'Offices' 1,211,990 (p4) and General Fund detail 'Offices' 1,183,385 (p5) set to category Fees of Office] These are county office fees, and the extractor's own detail line for the General Fund 'Offices' 1,183,385 (detail[6]) uses detail_category 'fees of office'. The user rule (2026-10-28) makes Fees of Office its own receipt category, separate from charges for services, so this line should be Fees of Office. detail[6].category has the same problem.

The printed label is Miscellaneous, and the same label in General Fund detail (detail[4], 526,024) is category other, so the category is inconsistent across the report. Calling the Self-Funded Insurance receipts (2,109,308, p20) charges for services is a judgment call. decision_needed already asks this.
The category rules put noxious weed control in natural resources/conservation. The extractor followed the statement's Public Works grouping so the function totals tie; this is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: County Visitors' Program Fund: Miscellaneous 54,144; Operating Expenses 16,569
issues.issue: County visitors' promotion funds normally receive lodging tax, and the rules put tourism spending in economic development. The revenue (detail[79]) is left as unexplained other and the spending (detail[80]) as general government. Worth a person's check.

Its detail_category is 'fees of office', but its category is licenses and permits. The user rule sends recording fees to Fees of Office. The statement p4 does print this amount inside 'Licenses and Permits'.
The Road Fund label is printed with a typo ('Miscellaneaous'). The extractor corrected it here but kept the typo for the ARPA line (detail[72]). Labels should be as printed.
